content: उक्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Said, spoken. .²2 Uttered, spoken (<ab>opp.</ab> to अनुमित or संभावित). .²3 Told, addressed; असावनुक्तो ऽपि सहाय एव <ls>Ku. 3. 21</ls>. .²4 Indicated; असता छाययोक्ताय सदाभासाय ते नमः <ls>Bhāg. 8. 3. 14</ls>. .{@-क्तम्@} A speech, words collectively; a sentence. .{@-क्तम्, -क्ता@} A stanza of four lines with one syllabic instant, (there being one long or two short syllables in each).
